title: Custom tool binaries in .agent/tools/bin
description: Declares the local tool scripts, their invocation, and I/O. Read by .agent/tests/smoke_mcp.sh (which asserts each declared bin exists and runs).

tools.name: code-search
tools.description: Search source under src/ for a pattern, respecting .gitignore.
tools.output: matching file:line:text lines on stdout; exit 0 even on no match

tools.name: security-scan
tools.description: Static scan of a path for hardcoded secrets and dangerous shell patterns.
tools.output: JSON on stdout: {findings:[{file,line,kind,snippet}], count}; exit 1 if findings
